item.title: [IGNITE-13636] ODBC driver assigns SQL_BINARY type to DATE fields
item.description:
"The DATE types should not be reported as SQL_BINARY. They should be returned as SQL_DATE"

DATE_FIELD DataType SQL_BINARY, DecimalDigits 0, Nullable 2, ColumnSize 10, UnsignedNumber 1, is_output_column
item.summary: ODBC driver assigns SQL_BINARY type to DATE fields
